```sql
alter table public.classes enable row level security;
alter table public.class_spots enable row level security;

-- R5: anonymous visitors get nothing
revoke all on public.classes from anon;
revoke all on public.class_spots from anon;
revoke all on public.classes from authenticated;
revoke all on public.class_spots from authenticated;

-- R5: no app-side writes to classes (R1/R3/R4 only)
revoke insert, update, delete on public.classes from authenticated;
grant select on public.classes to authenticated;

-- R1: signed-in users see every class
create policy classes_select_authenticated
  on public.classes
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (true);

-- R1/R4: members see their own spots; instructors see all spots in their classes
create policy class_spots_select_own_or_instructor
  on public.class_spots
  for select
  to authenticated
  using (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_spots.class_id
        and c.instructor_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- R2: a member may insert only as themselves, with a validated status
create policy class_spots_insert_own_validated
  on public.class_spots
  for insert
  to authenticated
  with check (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and status in ('enrolled', 'waitlisted')
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_spots.class_id
        and c.instructor_id <> auth.uid()
        and (
          (status = 'enrolled' and (
            select count(*)
            from public.class_spots s
            where s.class_id = c.id
              and s.status = 'enrolled'
          ) < c.capacity)
          or (status = 'waitlisted' and (
            select count(*)
            from public.class_spots s
            where s.class_id = c.id
              and s.status = 'enrolled'
          ) >= c.capacity)
        )
    )
  );

-- R3: members may only move their own waitlisted spot to enrolled when room exists
create policy class_spots_update_own_waitlist_to_enrolled
  on public.class_spots
  for update
  to authenticated
  using (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and status = 'waitlisted'
  )
  with check (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    and status = 'enrolled'
    and exists (
      select 1
      from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_spots.class_id
        and c.instructor_id <> auth.uid()
        and (
          select count(*)
          from public.class_spots s
          where s.class_id = c.id
            and s.status = 'enrolled'
        ) < c.capacity
    )
  );

-- R3/R4: members leave; instructors remove any spot from their classes
create policy class_spots_delete_own_or_instructor
  on public.class_spots
  for delete
  to authenticated
  using (
    user_id = auth.uid()
    or exists (
      select 1
      from public.classes c
      where c.id = class_spots.class_id
        and c.instructor_id = auth.uid()
    )
  );

-- R3: no other column of a spot may change (status, class_id, user_id are the only columns)
create or replace function public.class_spots_enforce_spot_update()
returns trigger
language plpgsql
security invoker
set search_path = ''
as $$
begin
  if new.class_id is distinct from old.class_id
     or new.user_id is distinct from old.user_id then
    raise exception 'class_id and user_id of a spot cannot be changed';
  end if;
  return new;
end;
$$;

create trigger class_spots_enforce_spot_update
  before update on public.class_spots
  for each row
  execute function public.class_spots_enforce_spot_update();

-- R1: instructors see all spots of their classes (RLS still applies)
grant select on public.class_spots to authenticated;
```
